column3: Close to the Greek; NKJV adds “this” to “life.”
NKJV has “it will come as a snare,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text joins “as a snare” to verse 34 and reads “for it will come upon all.”
NKJV has “Watch therefore” and “be counted worthy,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “But watch” and “have strength.”
